question:
What is the sum of all angles of all triangles in the given figure?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/15095fe305faa43aaca46b6773426cc1fbc2427803b7d30a9c607c48973076f2.png]
solution:
The sum of all angles of all triangles in the given figure:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/dc1d3c797f6f3c4c7a7565db17ba66ff0f7231163715bc5abb42cf16466370de.png] 

Total number of triangle is: 8.

The sum of triangle is 180°.

The sum of all triangle = 8 × 180° = 1440°.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 4".**
